segments.source: I founded Saturdays.AI so I could learn Deep Learning while building impact projects. I currently serve as president and help with the daily operations and the strategy in order to fulfill our mission. I’m a Data Geek with extensive management experience in industrial and technology companies. I’m also a MBA Graduate from HEC Paris and Wharton, with a track-record as an entrepreneur for mission-driven initiatives, and a part-time professor of Applied AI. Passionate about how technology empowers everyone to achieve great things, I’m on a quest to build a better tomorrow for my 3 children.
segments.en: I founded Saturdays.AI so I could learn Deep Learning while building impact projects. I currently serve as president and help with the daily operations and the strategy in order to fulfill our mission. I’m a Data Geek with extensive management experience in industrial and technology companies. I’m also a MBA Graduate from HEC Paris and Wharton, with a track-record as an entrepreneur for mission-driven initiatives, and a part-time professor of Applied AI. Passionate about how technology empowers everyone to achieve great things, I’m on a quest to build a better tomorrow for my 3 children.
segments.es: Fundé Saturdays.AI para poder aprender Deep Learning mientras construía proyectos de impacto. Actualmente me desempeño como presidente y ayudo con las operaciones diarias y la estrategia para cumplir nuestra misión. Soy un Data Geek con amplia experiencia en gestión en empresas industriales y tecnológicas. También tengo un MBA de HEC Paris y Wharton, con una trayectoria como emprendedor de iniciativas impulsadas por una misión y profesor a tiempo parcial de IA aplicada. Apasionado por cómo la tecnología permite a todos lograr grandes cosas, estoy en la búsqueda de construir un mañana mejor para mis 3 hijos.

segments.source: I co-founded Saturdays.AI back in 2018 willing to learn Deep Learning within a community of makers. More about me: I am a self-taught developer and former strategy consultant. My previous projects include an underwater augmented reality experience and a wearable to facilitate the navigation of the visually impaired from which I was nominated to the MIT Under 35. I’m actively involved in the Barcelona Entrepreneurship Scene through Startup Weekend, Global Shapers and StartupGrind among others.
segments.en: I co-founded Saturdays.AI back in 2018 willing to learn Deep Learning within a community of makers. More about me: I am a self-taught developer and former strategy consultant. My previous projects include an underwater augmented reality experience and a wearable to facilitate the navigation of the visually impaired from which I was nominated to the MIT Under 35. I’m actively involved in the Barcelona Entrepreneurship Scene through Startup Weekend, Global Shapers and StartupGrind among others.
segments.es: Cofundé Saturdays.AI en 2018 y estaba dispuesto a aprender aprendizaje profundo dentro de una comunidad de creadores. Más sobre mí: soy desarrollador autodidacta y ex consultor de estrategia. Mis proyectos anteriores incluyen una experiencia submarina de realidad aumentada y un wearable para facilitar la navegación a personas con discapacidad visual por el que fui nominado al MIT Under 35. Estoy implicado activamente en la Escena Emprendedora de Barcelona a través de Startup Weekend, Global Shapers y StartupGrind entre otros.

segments.source: I was born in Johannesburg, South Africa, but I have Spanish nationality. As Europe Manager, I oversee the operations and expansion in Europe. I am a tireless proactive and multidisciplinary learner, with good communication skills and always looking to be happy in what I do. I feel fulfilled by helping and teaching others. With great ability to work in a team and excellent leadership skills, experience and professionalism, I am always ready for new opportunities.

Soy una persona incansable, proactiva y multidisciplinaria, con buenas habilidades comunicativas y siempre buscando ser feliz en lo que hago. Me siento realizado ayudando y enseñando a otros. Con gran capacidad para trabajar en equipo y excelentes habilidades de liderazgo, experiencia y profesionalismo, siempre estoy listo para nuevas oportunidades.

segments.source: I lead the global team, provide support to the communities and also strategic advice. My great passion is the human brain, although I am a computer engineer by training and I have worked on several AI projects related to health. I have always been fascinated by psychology and neuroscience and believe that the complex interactions of our brain shape our thoughts, memories, feelings and motivations, and ultimately make us human. I like to talk about mental well-being in the modern world, habits, brain-computer interfaces, education, learning, productivity and creativity. You can read me at smartsapiens.net and recommend a good book 😉

segments.es: Lidero el equipo global, brindo apoyo a las comunidades y también asesoramiento estratégico. Mi gran pasión es el cerebro humano, aunque soy ingeniero informático de formación y he trabajado en varios proyectos de IA relacionados con la salud. Siempre me han fascinado la psicología y la neurociencia y creo que las complejas interacciones de nuestro cerebro dan forma a nuestros pensamientos, recuerdos, sentimientos y motivaciones y, en última instancia, nos hacen humanos. Me gusta hablar sobre bienestar mental en el mundo moderno, hábitos, interfaces cerebro-computadora, educación, aprendizaje, productividad y creatividad. Puedes leerme en smartsapiens.net y recomendar un buen libro 😉

segments.source: I bring Saturdays.AI’s mission to new communities as GTM Lead, combining over a decade in education with a builder’s instinct for growth. A certified teacher turned edtech entrepreneur, co-founder of LearniaClub and alumna of Telefónica Open Future and Banco Santander’s Yuzz program, I understand both the classroom and the ecosystem. My work has always centered on one question: how do I make transformative learning accessible to people who aren’t yet in the room? At Saturdays.AI, I turn that question into strategy.
segments.en: I bring Saturdays.AI’s mission to new communities as GTM Lead, combining over a decade in education with a builder’s instinct for growth. A certified teacher turned edtech entrepreneur, co-founder of LearniaClub and alumna of Telefónica Open Future and Banco Santander’s Yuzz program, I understand both the classroom and the ecosystem. My work has always centered on one question: how do I make transformative learning accessible to people who aren’t yet in the room? At Saturdays.AI, I turn that question into strategy.
segments.es: Llevo la misión de Saturdays.AI a nuevas comunidades como líder de GTM, combinando más de una década en educación con un instinto de crecimiento de constructor. Profesora certificada convertida en emprendedora de tecnología educativa, cofundadora de LearniaClub y alumna de Telefónica Open Future y del programa Yuzz del Banco Santander, entiendo tanto el aula como el ecosistema. Mi trabajo siempre se ha centrado en una pregunta: ¿cómo puedo hacer que el aprendizaje transformador sea accesible para las personas que aún no están presentes? En Saturdays.AI, convierto esa pregunta en estrategia.

segments.source: I’m a computer engineer passionate about technology and open source philosophy, eager to share knowledge and always motivated to learn. I have several postgraduate studies: a Masters in Business Administration and another in Data Science and Big Data, and I am co-founder of Women in Data Science, Power and Engineering AC.
segments.en: I’m a computer engineer passionate about technology and open source philosophy, eager to share knowledge and always motivated to learn. I have several postgraduate studies: a Masters in Business Administration and another in Data Science and Big Data, and I am co-founder of Women in Data Science, Power and Engineering AC.
segments.es: Soy un ingeniero informático apasionado por la tecnología y la filosofía open source, con muchas ganas de compartir conocimientos y siempre motivado por aprender. Tengo varios estudios de posgrado: una Maestría en Administración de Empresas y otra en Ciencia de Datos y Big Data, y soy cofundadora de Women in Data Science, Power and Engineering AC.

segments.source: I am a doctor in Intelligent Systems from ITESM and have collaborated in Yahoo Research and Microsoft Research in Machine Learning applications. I am a founding partner and the head of Analytics at Ensitech in Mexico, where I carry out Data Science projects for leading companies in the country. I am also a board member of CAINTRA’s Centro de Vinculación Tecnológica, founder of the Data Science community in Monterrey and a contributor to media such as Forbes, Economía Hoy and SG Software Guru.
segments.en: I am a doctor in Intelligent Systems from ITESM and have collaborated in Yahoo Research and Microsoft Research in Machine Learning applications. I am a founding partner and the head of Analytics at Ensitech in Mexico, where I carry out Data Science projects for leading companies in the country. I am also a board member of CAINTRA’s Centro de Vinculación Tecnológica, founder of the Data Science community in Monterrey and a contributor to media such as Forbes, Economía Hoy and SG Software Guru.
segments.es: Soy doctor en Sistemas Inteligentes del ITESM y he colaborado en Yahoo Research y Microsoft Research en aplicaciones de Machine Learning. Soy socio fundador y responsable de Analytics de Ensitech en México, donde llevo a cabo proyectos de Ciencia de Datos para empresas líderes del país. También soy miembro de la junta directiva del Centro de Vinculación Tecnológica de CAINTRA, fundador de la comunidad de Ciencia de Datos en Monterrey y colaborador de medios como Forbes, Economía Hoy y SG Software Guru.

segments.source: My goal is to help people to better adapt to a world that, fortunately or not, will be increasingly digital. If I had to apply a motto to myself, «Kaizen» would be my keyword of choice. During my life, I have noticed that continuous improvement can get an individual quite far.
segments.en: My goal is to help people to better adapt to a world that, fortunately or not, will be increasingly digital. If I had to apply a motto to myself, «Kaizen» would be my keyword of choice. During my life, I have noticed that continuous improvement can get an individual quite far.
segments.es: Mi objetivo es ayudar a las personas a adaptarse mejor a un mundo que, afortunadamente o no, será cada vez más digital. Si tuviera que aplicarme un lema, «Kaizen» sería mi palabra clave preferida. Durante mi vida, he notado que la mejora continua puede llevar a una persona bastante lejos.

segments.source: I was a student in the 1st edition of AI Saturdays Barcelona and mentor later in the 1st edition of Tarragona. I returned to Ecuador and became the city lead of AI Saturdays Guayaquil. I’m a teacher and an entrepreneur in constant learning, in search of generating a positive impact by sharing and applying the knowledge acquired at work, studies and in life. One of my goals is to make Ecuador one of the countries with the highest technology development worldwide. I love technology and I have experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, control, electricity, robotics and telecommunications. Also, in the design of mobile applications with acquired skills in administration, in competitive analysis, resource and project management and in implementation of processes and tools focused on improving service/product too. At the moment, I am working on the development of an autonomous vehicle.

segments.es: Fui alumna en la 1ª edición de AI Saturdays Barcelona y mentora posteriormente en la 1ª edición de Tarragona. Regresé a Ecuador y me convertí en líder municipal de AI Saturdays Guayaquil. Soy docente y emprendedora en constante aprendizaje, en busca de generar un impacto positivo compartiendo y aplicando los conocimientos adquiridos en el trabajo, los estudios y la vida. Uno de mis objetivos es hacer del Ecuador uno de los países con mayor desarrollo tecnológico a nivel mundial. Me encanta la tecnología y tengo experiencia en Ciencia de Datos, Machine Learning, control, electricidad, robótica y telecomunicaciones. Asimismo, en el diseño de aplicaciones móviles con habilidades adquiridas en administración, en análisis competitivo, gestión de recursos y proyectos y en implementación de procesos y herramientas enfocadas a la mejora del servicio/producto. Actualmente estoy trabajando en el desarrollo de un vehículo autónomo.
